title: Manufacturer sample kits on the Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
When a customer's current catheter or absorbent product does not suit them, Larkfield may send a no-charge manufacturer sample kit on the Urology and Continence Supply Program. The kit is of an alternative item of the program's product line, so that the customer can choose a new product with their practitioner.

## Terms of a sample kit

- A sample is never billed. It draws no authorized units and does not count toward the allowance.
- A sample kit is sent only while the program's sample kits in the rolling 12 months ending on the sample ship date are fewer than the tier's sample kit limit. The count is the program's sample shipments whose ship date falls in the 365 calendar days ending on, and including, the sample ship date being considered.
- A product the customer chooses after a trial is supplied only after a new written order names it.

| Hypothetical, tier limit of 2 kits: kits already sent in the 365 days ending on the new ship date | Send another? |
|---|---|
| 1 | yes |
| 2 | no |
